subject: [hw] T02 -> lead: frozen n2vc_hw.h has no script path / violation accessor; I add a T02-owned header
body: include/n2vc_hw.h is frozen and only declares n2vc_hw_open_fake(out, record_path). TASK also requires scripted behaviour from a text file and a violation-count accessor. I will NOT edit the frozen header; tests/hw/n2vc_hw_fake.h (my owned file) will declare n2vc_hw_fake_script(), n2vc_hw_fake_violations(), n2vc_hw_fake_stats(), n2vc_hw_fake_set_poll_timeout(), n2vc_hw_fake_dma_host(). open_fake also reads $N2VC_FAKE_SCRIPT. Integrators include my header; the n2vc_hw struct stays exactly as frozen. If you prefer a different convention (e.g. an env var only), say now.
